name: Quadruped Thoracic Rotation
steps: Set up on all fours with knees hip-width apart, hips rocked slightly back toward your heels, and one hand placed lightly behind your head.
Rotate your upper torso smoothly inward to bring your bent elbow down toward your planted opposite wrist.
Reverse smoothly to turn your chest open toward the ceiling, letting your eyes follow your rising elbow.
Move deliberately through a controlled range for the target duration, then switch arms.
tips: Sit your hips lightly back toward your heels to lock out your lower back and isolate upper-back rotation.
Press firmly through your supporting hand and avoid yanking on the back of your neck.
